samples.question: This picture shows a scattered mending kit on a plain white background. Exactly one item is drawn in a strong colour: a single zipper, drawn as one straight coloured tape with short coloured teeth attached along it. Every other mark is plain grey - including grey zippers with teeth of their own - and every grey mark is decoration that must be ignored; no grey mark touches or overlaps the coloured zipper. Each tooth of the coloured zipper is attached to the tape and sticks out from exactly one side of it. Walk along the coloured tape from one end to the other and look at each pair of teeth that are neighbours along the tape, with no other tooth between them. Call such a pair a same-side pair when both of its teeth stick out from the same side of the tape. The teeth in this picture may follow any pattern of sides, and the answer is the same whichever end of the tape you start from. How many same-side pairs does the coloured zipper have? Answer with exactly one of: 0, 1, 2, 3.
